# canvas

```go
import "github.com/lucasassuncao/bezel/component/canvas"
```

Package canvas is free drawing in braille: lines, boxes, circles, points and labels placed in the app's own units, each in a series colour.

<a name="Circle"></a>
## type [Circle](<https://github.com/lucasassuncao/bezel/blob/main/component/canvas/shape.go#L40-L43>)

Circle is the outline round X, Y at radius R, in the canvas's units, so a region wider than it is tall draws it as an ellipse.

```go
type Circle struct {
    X, Y, R float64
    Series  int
}
```

<a name="Label"></a>
## type [Label](<https://github.com/lucasassuncao/bezel/blob/main/component/canvas/shape.go#L82-L86>)

Label is Text written from the cell that holds X, Y, over any dots there; what passes the right edge is cut, and escape codes are dropped.

```go
type Label struct {
    X, Y   float64
    Text   string
    Series int
}
```

<a name="Line"></a>
## type [Line](<https://github.com/lucasassuncao/bezel/blob/main/component/canvas/shape.go#L16-L19>)

Line runs from X0, Y0 to X1, Y1.

```go
type Line struct {
    X0, Y0, X1, Y1 float64
    Series         int
}
```

<a name="Model"></a>
## type [Model](<https://github.com/lucasassuncao/bezel/blob/main/component/canvas/canvas.go#L27-L32>)

Model is a drawing over the region xMin..xMax by yMin..yMax, y growing upwards. A value: every method returns the new canvas.

```go
type Model struct {
    // contains filtered or unexported fields
}
```

```go
func New(xMin, xMax, yMin, yMax float64) Model
```

New is an empty canvas over x from xMin to xMax and y from yMin to yMax. It draws nothing until SetWidth and SetHeight size it.

### func \(Model\) [View](<https://github.com/lucasassuncao/bezel/blob/main/component/canvas/canvas.go#L92>)


<a name="Point"></a>
## type [Point](<https://github.com/lucasassuncao/bezel/blob/main/component/canvas/shape.go#L62>)

Point is a place on the canvas, in its units.

```go
type Point struct{ X, Y float64 }
```

<a name="Points"></a>
## type [Points](<https://github.com/lucasassuncao/bezel/blob/main/component/canvas/shape.go#L65-L68>)

Points is one dot at each of Coords, as a scatter plot.

```go
type Points struct {
    Coords []Point
    Series int
}
```

<a name="Rect"></a>
## type [Rect](<https://github.com/lucasassuncao/bezel/blob/main/component/canvas/shape.go#L25-L28>)

Rect is the outline of the box from X, Y \(its bottom left corner\), W wide and H tall.

```go
type Rect struct {
    X, Y, W, H float64
    Series     int
}
```

<a name="Shape"></a>
## type [Shape](<https://github.com/lucasassuncao/bezel/blob/main/component/canvas/shape.go#L11-L13>)

Shape is what Draw takes: Line, Rect, Circle, Points or Label. Series picks the shape's colour from Styles.Series, wrapping round it.

```go
    // contains filtered or unexported methods
```
